description: This file defines a React functional component 'DisplayOptionsMenu' that renders a menu for configuring display preferences related to notes, tags, and views within a web application. It manages user preferences, interacts with an application object for persisting settings, and provides UI controls for sorting, view options, and other display-related features.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Refreshes local preference states from the application preferences, considering current mode (global or tag-specific).

methods.name: changeGlobalPreferences
methods.description: Updates global application preferences with provided partial preferences.

methods.name: changeSystemViewPreferences
methods.description: Updates preferences specific to a system view associated with a tag.

methods.name: changePreferences
methods.description: Dispatches preference updates to the appropriate scope: global, system view, or specific tag.

methods.name: resetTagPreferences
methods.description: Resets preferences for a specific tag or system view to defaults.

methods.name: toggleSortBy
methods.description: Changes the sorting property (date, title, etc.).

methods.name: toggleEntryMode
methods.description: Switches between daily and normal entry modes for tags.

methods.name: toggleTableView
methods.description: Switches the note list to a table view layout.
